name: Akai Kiyoharu
source:
The Guuji of the local shrine, Akai Aso Jinja.
There are rumors that he once had a deep connection to the Former Imperial Railway.

[spoiler]He used to be the test driver for experimental highspeed train Kuha26, his dedication to the job cost his marriage.[/spoiler]
